description: We are Pioneer Matrix from Ahmedabad, competing in the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge. Our vision is to democratize deep-space discovery with SphereX, an open-source, browser-based platform that makes NASA’s 102-band infrared sky surveys accessible to everyone. By empowering citizen scientists to visually explore multi-epoch cosmic shifts, we aim to turn everyday curiosity into active participation in uncovering the universe's hidden wonders.
